app.name: Paleta Musical
app.tagline: Hear and explore notes, scales and chords.

palette.title: Palette
palette.emptyTitle: The full palette is on its way
palette.emptyBody: For now, play the 12 notes or use your computer keyboard.
palette.keyboardHint: Computer keyboard: <keys></keys> play one octave; <down></down> and <up></up> change the octave.
palette.shortcutPlay: Play a note (A W S E D F T G Y H U J K)

progressions.title: Progressions
progressions.emptyBody: Here you will find progressions by style, the chord builder and the shared timeline.

endless.title: Endless
endless.description: A chord generator that never stops.
endless.emptyTitle: The endless generator is coming soon
endless.emptyBody: Here you will generate random chords in a style, without stopping.

chords.title: Chords
chords.emptyTitle: The chord finder is coming soon
chords.emptyBody: Here you will pick notes and see the chords they make.

harmony.title: Harmony
harmony.emptyTitle: The circle of fifths is coming soon
harmony.emptyBody: Here you will explore keys, cadences and neighbour chords.

analyse.title: Analyse
analyse.description: Key and chords of an audio file.
analyse.emptyBody: Here you will load an audio file and see its likely scale and chords.
analyse.rollEmptyTitle: The piano roll is coming soon
analyse.rollEmptyBody: Here you will edit the detected notes and export them as MIDI.
